display.purpose: Page hero only; one per page; solid color, never gradient-filled.

headline.purpose: Section titles for major sections; quiet sections step down one size.

body.purpose: Max 70ch line length; #CBD5E1 on navy, #1E293B on light surfaces.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked labels, four words or fewer.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Default card edge; most surfaces need nothing more.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive cards on hover, with a small translateY.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and modals floating above the page.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: The single primary CTA per viewport (One Glow Rule).

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Entrance reveal; must have a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce alternative.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold CTA on navy; calm 2px lift on hover, no scale.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D4A017 0%, #F59E0B 100%); color: #0A1628; padding: 1rem 2rem; border-radius: 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #10B981; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tonal surface button with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); padding: 1rem 2rem; border-radius: 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-color: #D4A017; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #10B981; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The PugliAI logo draws Puglia's olive tree as a circuit diagram, and that object anchors every color decision: green #1B9032 and blue #135CA9 on a midnight navy ground. The interface is a deep institutional environment where whitespace and typographic confidence carry the premium positioning. The system rejects generic AI-startup SaaS, Big-4 sterility, agency-template clutter, and crypto-style neon hype; authority is carried by evidence framed calmly.
keyCharacteristics: Dark institutional ground (midnight navy), never dark-mode-for-coolness
Logo-anchored brand color: green for growth and identity, blue for intelligence and trust
One typeface (Inter) with strong weight contrast doing all hierarchy work
Glass surfaces tamed to structure, not decoration
Evidence-first composition: metrics and proof framed with restraint

rules.name: The Logo Anchor Rule
rules.body: Every new color decision traces back to the logo: green #1B9032, blue #135CA9, on navy. If a proposed accent isn't one of those (or a tint), it needs a reason.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow shadows appear on at most one element per viewport — the primary CTA. Everywhere else, depth comes from borders and tonal steps.

rules.name: The Solid Ink Rule
rules.body: Headings are set in a single solid color (white, green, or blue). Gradient-filled text is prohibited in new work and removed where found.

rules.name: The Nav-Only Blur Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter belongs to the fixed navigation and floating overlays. Content cards use flat tonal surfaces.

dos: Do anchor every accent decision to the logo: Olive Green #1B9032 and Circuit Blue #135CA9 on Midnight Navy.
Do set headings in solid white, green, or blue — emphasis via weight and size.
Do keep body text ≥16px at ≥4.5:1 contrast for the executive audience.
Do use hairline borders and tonal steps for depth; reserve blur for the fixed nav and overlays.
Do vary section rhythm: major sections breathe, supporting sections compress.
Do maintain Italian/English parity in every component and layout change.
donts: Don't build generic AI-startup SaaS: purple gradients, identical feature-card grids, stock 3D blobs, buzzword copy.
Don't drift into Big-4 sterility or cheap agency-template patterns: carousels everywhere, animated counters, icon soup.
Don't use crypto/tech-bro hype: neon glows, dark-mode-for-coolness, FOMO claims.
Don't fill text with gradients (background-clip: text) — including stat numbers and prices.
Don't use colored side-stripes (border-left > 1px) on callouts, alerts, or list items.
Don't stack glass: no blur-on-blur, no cards inside cards.
Don't let gold spread: no new gold gradients, glows, or scrollbars; one glow per viewport on the primary CTA only.
Don't repeat one identical card grid as the answer to every section.
